title: Conditional Hypothesis Record
description: A falsifiable, scope-conditioned hypothesis addressing one or more open questions (especially core questions Q-001..Q-003). Unlike unstructured note claims, every hypothesis carries explicit scope_conditions (preventing unconditional mutual contradiction across contexts) and a mandatory exclusion_clause stating what empirical measurement, primary-source collision, or thought-experiment counterexample would refute or narrow it. Append-only: lineage evolves via parent_hypothesis_ids and evaluations, never by rewriting past rows.

hypothesis_id.description: Collision-resistant ID minted via tools/new_id.py HYP (HYP-YYYYMMDD-xxxxxx).

session_id.description: Session that formulated or registered this hypothesis.

scope_conditions.description: Explicit boundary conditions, transformation classes, or observation regimes under which the proposition is claimed to hold.

exclusion_clause.description: Mandatory falsification criterion: concrete observation, ledger measurement, or textual counterexample that would refute or force narrowing of this hypothesis.

lineage_op.description: How this hypothesis relates to parent_hypothesis_ids.

parent_hypothesis_ids.description: Empty when lineage_op is 'root'; non-empty otherwise.

status.description: Initial status at registration; tools/belief_state.py computes effective posterior status and weight after applying all evaluations.
